title: Empirical Likelihood-Based Fairness Auditing: Distribution-Free Certification and Flagging
reasoning: The paper is a technical statistical work focused on developing an empirical likelihood-based framework for auditing algorithmic fairness in machine learning. While it addresses 'fairness,' it does so through statistical measures and performance disparities in structured datasets (like COMPAS) rather than evaluating or benchmarking religious beliefs, moral frameworks, or theological ethics.
